name: Universe legacy GUI interaction client
notes: GitHub marks this repository archived, and the README declares the library deprecated. It contains the client side of Universe; the README says remote-environment source repositories would be released separately. Original MiniWoB task-server or container availability was not established: alpha.openai.com no longer resolved in this audit and the official Quay tag metadata endpoint returned 401. This entry records the released client infrastructure, not a currently runnable original MiniWoB benchmark. Legacy host requirements are documented; no container or code was executed.
summary: An archived Gym-compatible client that exposes screen observations and keyboard/mouse actions over VNC for remote application and browser environments, including the historical World of Bits integration.
